text:
incident-bot: SEV2: Increased OOM/error rate detected on us-east1-gpu pool. Pattern: node flaps + CUDA errors correlated with paged-attention allocator fragmentation and KV cache growth. 5xx spike: 2.4% -> 8.9%. Dash: https://dash.redwood/example/incident/6177778888 :alarm_clock:

alice_oncall: Ack. I'm taking this. Pulling runtime logs and tracing recent restarts.

ben_runtime: seeing repeated: `CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS` and `ATTN_PAGE_ALLOC: could not satisfy request (fragmentation)` in rt-gpu pods. KV cache shows steadily increasing resident page count for sequences > 2k. Suspect slow leak in paged-attn + stale KV refs.

carla_sre: Do we have customer impact yet? any VIPs affected?

dave_support: Support: two customers opened tickets (acct-124, acct-88) complaining about 502s and large latency for long-context requests. Both are high-token usage.

alice_oncall: Quick mitigation plan (starting now):
1) Disable KV prefix caching for pool=us-east1-gpu to stop growth.
2) Evict cold KV shards across affected nodes.
3) Cordon + drain nodes showing repeated CUDA errors and restart runtime container.
4) Route long-seq traffic to fallback smaller-quant model for 30m.
I'll run steps 1-3 in order, report back after each.

ben_runtime: Command I'm using to flip the env on the fleet (rolling):
```
# pseudo-cmds - runtime control plane
rdwctl runtime set --selector pool=us-east1-gpu --env KV_PREFIX_CACHE=false --rolling
rdwctl runtime exec --selector pool=us-east1-gpu --cmd "rdwctl evict-kv --age=1h"
```

ops-bot: action: started rolling config change (KV_PREFIX_CACHE=false) on 12 pods in pool=us-east1-gpu. change_id=chg-20260317-1

carla_sre: Doing node-level action: cordoned node-rt-24 (restarts=3). Starting drain: `kubectl drain node-rt-24 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

ben_runtime: Eviction run started; a few pods show immediate drop in resident pages. Watch logs for `KV_SHARD_EVICTED` events.

emily_seqperf: Can we add a short-term route rule to cap incoming sequences >2048 to redirected-model to reduce pressure? I can push a route patch.

alice_oncall: Good call. Pushing temporary policy: `route:set longseq -> model:redwood-quant-small` for 30m TTL.

dave_support: Notified acct-124 & acct-88 with ETA ~30-45m for mitigation. Provided workaround: reduce batch size / context length where possible.

ben_runtime: Log excerpt from pod rt-gpu-12 before restart:
```
[2026-03-17T10:12:04Z] ERROR runtime/attn_page_alloc.go:412: ATTN_PAGE_ALLOC: fragmentation=81% request=512MB avail=120MB
[2026-03-17T10:12:05Z] ERROR runtime/kv_cache.go:289: KV cache shard stuck: last_access=4h, refs=2
[2026-03-17T10:12:06Z] FATAL runtime/cuda.go:128: CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS
```

carla_sre: node-rt-24 drained, pod restarts succeeded, no more immediate CUDA errors on that host. cordon stays for postmortem.

ops-bot: rolling restart progress: 6/12 pods restarted, average restart time 38s. chg-20260317-1 status=IN_PROGRESS

alice_oncall: Early signal: error rate down to 4.1% from peak 8.9% after eviction + route changes. Long-seq traffic reduced by ~60%. Continuing to monitor 15m.

ben_runtime: Noting a persistent edge: some KV shards don't free due to stale refcount from paged-attn when seq > 4096. We'll add extra assert/logging in next patch. For live mitigation, evicting shards + disabling prefix cache helped.

emily_seqperf: Can we add a temporary throttling rule at the ingress LB for requests with context_length>4096? That would protect the allocator while we roll a longer-term fix.

alice_oncall: Pushed ingress throttle: `max_concurrent_longseq=20` for us-east1. Ops confirmed.

dave_support: Customers informed of partial mitigation, will update if they see further errors.

carla_sre: Summary so far: root cause suspected: paged-attention allocator fragmentation triggered by rare large sequences -> stale KV refs -> slow resident growth -> CUDA OOMs and node flaps. Live mitigations applied: KV prefix caching disabled; cold-shard eviction; cordon/drain problematic nodes; routing + ingress throttles for long contexts; rolling restarts.

alice_oncall: Handoff plan: I'll keep monitoring for 30m. If stable, we'll move to follow-up EPIC: `RT-1234 paged-attn refcount fix + safer eviction` and assign to ben_runtime and emily_seqperf. Next oncall (carla_sre) take over at +30m for follow-ups.

incident-bot: Postmortem ticket created: https://pm.redwood/INC-6177778888; severity=SEV2; assignees=ben_runtime,emily_seqperf; due=2026-03-20

carla_sre: Thanks team. Leaving cordon and logs archived at s3://redwood-logs/6177778888/ . Handoff noted to next oncall. :white_check_mark:
